    # Debt-to-equity: (L0 + dL*x) <= 1.75 * (E0 + dE*x)
    maxDE = Q("1.75")
    # (L0 - 1.75*E0) <= x*(1.75*dE - dL)
    x_lev = (L0 - maxDE * E0) / (maxDE * dE - dL)
    x_lev = max(x_lev, Q(0))

    # Equity-to-assets: E >= 0.3 * (L + E)
    minEA = Q("0.3")
    # E0 + dE*x >= 0.3*(L0+E0 + (dL+dE)*x)
    # x*(dE - 0.3*(dL+dE)) >= 0.3*(L0+E0) - E0
    x_eq = (minEA * (L0 + E0) - E0) / (dE - minEA * (dL + dE))
    x_eq = max(x_eq, Q(0))

    final = max(x_lev, x_eq)
    return {
        "final": final,
        "equity_after_result": E0,
        "injection_leverage_only": x_lev,
        "injection_equity_ratio_only": x_eq,
    }

def solve():
    L0 = Q(1480000)           # liabilities before injection
    E0 = Q(420000)            # equity before net result
    net_result = Q(45000)     # positive = profit
    repay_share = Q("0.20")   # share of injection repaying liabilities
    fee_rate = Q("0.01")      # prepayment fee on the repaid amount, expensed
    max_de = Q("1.75")
    min_ea = Q("0.30")

    # Equity after booking net result, before any injection
    E1 = E0 + net_result

    # After injection X:
    #   L(X) = L0 - repay_share*X
    #   E(X) = E1 + X - fee_rate*repay_share*X
    eq_coef = 1 - fee_rate * repay_share
    liab_coef = -repay_share

    # Debt-to-equity covenant: L(X) <= max_de * E(X)
    # L0 + liab_coef*X <= max_de*E1 + max_de*eq_coef*X
    de_slope = max_de * eq_coef - liab_coef
    x_de = (L0 - max_de * E1) / de_slope
    inj_lev = max(x_de, Q(0))

    # Equity-to-assets covenant: E(X) >= min_ea*(L(X)+E(X))
    # (1-min_ea)*E(X) >= min_ea*L(X)
    ea_slope = (1 - min_ea) * eq_coef - min_ea * liab_coef
    x_ea = (min_ea * L0 - (1 - min_ea) * E1) / ea_slope
    inj_ea = max(x_ea, Q(0))

    final = max(inj_lev, inj_ea)
    return {
        "final": final,
        "equity_after_result": E1,
        "injection_leverage_only": inj_lev,
        "injection_equity_ratio_only": inj_ea,
    }
